dedupe_keys.name: a three year building operational performance dataset for informing energy efficiency

description: A three-year building operational performance dataset for informing energy efficiency is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This dataset was curated from an office building constructed in 2015 in Berkeley, California, which includes whole-building and end-use energy consumption, HVAC system operating conditions, indoor and outdoor environmental parameters, and occupant counts. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are building energy consumption, building energy efficiency. The portal shows 2024-07-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
